assets.licence: Public domain (US-government work, NASA) - NASA Media Usage Guidelines: "NASA content ... generally are not subject to copyright in the United States" (nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/, linked as 'Reproduction Guidelines' from the source page)
assets.notes: DERIVED FILE made locally for this project: the public-domain NASA/WMAP 9-year ILC map (download_url) was reprojected and rendered as a slowly rotating sphere on black, 1920x1080, 30 fps, one seamless full turn in 20 s (loopable), H.264 CRF 14, no audio. No licence beyond the NASA source applies; say 'visualisation based on NASA/WMAP data' if you credit it.

assets.title: WMAP 9-year CMB map, equirectangular (cylindrical) sphere texture - DERIVED reprojection
assets.licence: Public domain (US-government work, NASA) - NASA Media Usage Guidelines: "NASA content ... generally are not subject to copyright in the United States" (nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/, linked as 'Reproduction Guidelines' from the source page)
assets.notes: DERIVED FILE made locally: NASA's Mollweide PNG (download_url) reprojected to a 4096x2048 equirectangular texture (bilinear resampling) so it can be wrapped on a sphere. NASA does not publish this projection as an image; treat as a re-projection of public-domain NASA data.
